name: Toushin Omega
source:
Omega was the 24th Toushin to be constructed, and the ultimate Toushin. It has the most offensive capabilities and specializations ever fitted to a Toushin. Toushin Toshi Omega was designed to deal heavy weapons damage, and was more of a specialized military base than the other Toushin Toshi.

It was originally designed to retrofit [url=/c98002]Freak Paraffin[/url], but Freak was afraid of the idea of losing his sense of self and individuality, backing out at the last minute, as a result, M.M Rune had it sealed beneath the ground.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Freak_Paraffin]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
